messages:
anya: FYI running helm upgrade gpupool-operator prod-eu-west1 and it got stuck in a pre-upgrade hook. job keeps failing with webhook connect errors :grimacing:

mike: ugh, which webhook? conversion or validating?

anya: conversion webhook for gpupool.crd.example.com — job logs show upstream connection errors to webhook svc

cheng: can you paste pod logs from the hook job?

anya: here (truncated):
```
I0301 12:03:14.123456 1 main.go:78] starting conversion webhook
E0301 12:03:15.234567 1 server.go:112] http: Handler timeout
time="2025-03-01T12:03:15Z" level=error msg="upstream connect error or disconnect" grpc.code=Internal grpc.method=Convert grpc.service=crd.conversion
```

mike: looks like api-server can't reach the webhook service endpoint — maybe egress from control plane to webhook nodes is blocked

tess: didn’t we land that terraform change last night that tightened cluster egress policy for kube-apiserver? could be related.

anya: terraform plan shows we applied network egress deny for `kube-system` -> internet, but webhook runs in `gpupool-system`. not same ns but there was also a rule that SNATs control-plane traffic via a nat-gw that we rotated. maybe rotation misconfigured.

cheng: quick check: can someone curl the webhook endpoint from a control-plane like path? we don't have direct shell on control plane but we can check svc endpoints and pod IPs

mike: `kubectl get endpoints gpupool-webhook -n gpupool-system -o yaml` -> endpoints look healthy, but nodeIPs are in a subnet that our new NAT denies.

anya: omg — last night the terraform change added a deny for egress from that subnet to the NAT gateway unless tag=controlplane. control-plane traffic lost SNAT route.

deploy-bot: helm upgrade gpupool-operator v3.4.1 started by anya at 2025-03-01T12:00:00Z :arrow_up_small:

mike: two options: revert terraform egress change (fastest) or temporarily scale webhook to hostNetwork / NodePort so api-server can reach it without nat.

tess: revert will touch infra and needs approvals, but quicker to patch webhook svc to NodePort for the short window. anyone comfortable with that?

cheng: I can do the NodePort patch and test. command I'll run: `kubectl patch svc gpupool-webhook -n gpupool-system -p '{"spec": {"type": "NodePort"}}'` then check conversion again.

anya: +1 do it. also bump pre-upgrade hook timeout so it doesn't spam.

cheng: patched svc -> NodePort. verified nodePorts assigned and endpoints reachable from nodes.

mike: re-triggered the job: `kubectl delete job gpupool-preupgrade-xxxx -n gpupool-system` then recreate via helm upgrade --wait. logs now show conversion success:
```
I0301 12:11:20.987654 1 convert.go:45] conversion completed for 3 objects
```

anya: upgrade progressed past hooks and helm release is now 3.4.1 :tada:

tess: follow-up: we'll open a tiny terraform rollback PR to restore control-plane SNAT rule while we vet the nat rotation. longer term we need an explicit test for control-plane -> cluster svc egress during infra changes.

mike: adding a CI smoke step to any terraform that touches nat/egress — simulate conversion webhook call to a dummy svc.

anya: thanks all. I'll leave a runbook note: if conversion webhooks fail during helm upgrade, check recent egress/nat TF changes, consider NodePort patch as temporary unblock.

deploy-bot: incident created #INC-4721 (gpupool-upgrade-blocked) and linked to this thread.
